readPFM: read a PFM file and return the numpy array data and scale factor
write_pfm: write a numpy array as a PFM file to the given path with optional scale
readPFM_color: read a color PFM file with PF header and return height width 3 data
readPFM_grayscale: read a grayscale PFM file with Pf header and return height width data
write_pfm_flow: write a 2 channel flow field as a PFM file by padding to 3 channels
